description: Generate lyrical elf names from original Sindarin-flavored syllable banks — male, female, or with a woodland epithet.

faqs.a: No. The syllables are original creations with an elvish flavor — you will never get Galadriel or Legolas here.
It adds a poetic title like “of the Silverwood” to each name, perfect for rangers and wanderers.
faqs.q: What does the epithet style do?

faqs.a: Yes — every combination is generated fresh, so they are yours to use in any original work.
faqs.q: Can I use these in my own stories?

howto: Pick male, female, or epithet style.
Choose how many names to generate.
Press Generate, then click any name to copy it.
title: Elf Name Generator
